noise_6step_check.diagnosis: NO_NOISE. After exact peel with compression_jpeg:1 the residual is identically zero (std=0.0), so no stochastic component exists. The §B numbers above were measured on the jpeg:2 peel where residual is JPEG-mismatch structure (std=9.0): extreme_pct=52.87% is the documented JPEG-artifact false positive (extreme_pct>50% with noise_prior sigma<5), spatial_corr=0.65 and cross_ch_corr=0.84 reflect structured JPEG error, not noise. Initial sigma=1.11 from run_full_analysis is JPEG-artifact induced (degraded image itself is JPEG-compressed; clean is not).

final_decision.rationale: Single deterministic JPEG step. block_boundary=1.3297 (0% FP signal) + dct_zero_ratio=0.7528. Severity scan: jpeg:2 -> 29.07dB (CI 8/10), jpeg:3 -> 26.51dB (CI 8/10), jpeg:1 -> MSE=0 exact reproduction (CI 10/10). Verified on all 5 support pairs: clean_i degraded with compression_jpeg:1 is byte-identical to degraded_i. Exact reproduction excludes noise, blur and any global step. Blur ruled out independently (spectral_slope_ratio=1.0003, anisotropy=0). Global ruled out (variance_ratio=0.9888, mean_shift=0.1).

reanalysis.step2_noise_reinterpretation: R0's GAUSSIAN_YCrCb flag is a JPEG-artifact false positive, now supported by three independent checks: (1) per-pair sigma is grossly inconsistent (0.37/0.62/1.11/2.22/4.32) for one fixed pipeline - a real noise step would yield a content-stable sigma; pairs crossing the sigma>=2 gate (p1=2.22, p3=4.32) do not produce any coherent noise signature; (2) cross_channel_corr 0.2271-0.6836 and gamma_suspect arise from the JPEG YCrCb color transform and JPEG residual-intensity correlation; residual_intensity_corr sign flips across pairs (-0.287/+0.077/+0.324/+0.110/-0.095), which a deterministic gamma transform cannot do; (3) peeled residual after compression_jpeg:1 is identically zero (std=0.0, ch_stds all 0.0) on pair0 and pair3. The peeled §B extreme_pct=100% on a zero residual is the documented degenerate FP (zero_ratio=1.0 means every residual pixel is zero, not that all pixels are outliers). -> NO_NOISE.
reanalysis.step3_blur: NO_BLUR on all pairs: spectral_slope_ratio 0.9966-1.0023, far below 1.08. Threshold-boundary case: pair1 gm_ratio=0.7102 is just under the noise-conditional 0.72 threshold, but the noise-conditional rule uses spectral slope (flat), and a real mild blur would raise the slope ratio and also break exact JPEG reproduction. Counterfactual blur_gaussian:1+jpeg:1 = 28.10 dB vs inf for jpeg:1 alone -> blur rejected quantitatively.
reanalysis.step4_global: NO_GLOBAL on all pairs. decision.reason: The R0 pipeline reproduces all 5 support pairs byte-identically, which is the strongest possible signal evidence for the effective degradation. Signal re-interpretation found no overlooked step: the only anomalies (sigma boundary, gm_ratio boundary, clipping flag) are explained by JPEG artifacts or image content. R0 support_psnr=30.35 reflects specialist training/capacity, not misidentification, so the pipeline is retained.
